finalText:
**Build passes now, 0 errors.**

Two real bugs, not noise, both from the bundler bump:

- [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
- [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) threw when `backoffEnabled` was `undefined`. New config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`. Simplified to `flags.backoffEnabled === true`.

The rest is just deprecation and dedupe noise from the bump, 8 warnings total, all pre-existing chatter. Nothing left to do.
